glossZh: 动因，起作用的人或物（抽象）
glossEn: an active and efficient cause; capable of producing a certain effect
note: an active and efficient cause; capable of producing a certain effect。线索：the agent of change / a double agent。抽象义。

glossZh: 代理人，代表（受托行事者）
glossEn: a representative who acts on behalf of other persons or organizations
note: a representative who acts on behalf of other persons or organizations。线索：a real estate agent / an agent for。现有中文的「政府代表」是这个义位的子类型。

glossEn: a substance that exerts some force or effect
note: a substance that exerts some force or effect。线索：a chemical / cleaning + agent。区分 s2 看是不是「物质」。

glossEn: a businessman who buys or sells for another in exchange for a commission
note: a businessman who buys or sells for another in exchange for a commission。与 s2 分界：是否以营利为目的（commission）。
